displayPattern: Amber status LED on a Carrier Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump or 24VNA9 air conditioner. A short flash is 0.25 seconds on and a long flash is 1.0 second on. Code 57 is 5 short and 7 long
meaning: Suction pressure sensor fault. The suction pressure transducer reading cannot be trusted. There is no reset time on this row.
causes: Electrical short destroyed the transducer electronics
diySteps: Count 5 short flashes and 7 long flashes. Do not add refrigerant because a pressure sensor failed
Technician: compare the transducer reading with a gauge at the service valve, using the transducer chart in the manual. Correct an electrical short and replace the transducer
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. Gauge work and transducer replacement are not homeowner checks.
sourceTitle: Carrier Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump / 24VNA9 air conditioner Service Manual (4SM)
